## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; credit stress rising (HYG/LQD showing weakness) and sector breadth confirm downside. VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION and SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND provide context.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -1.72%) BELOW TREND show tightening (HYG/LQD ↓ falling). Energy-driven price action (XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising) and a firm dollar (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.86% ABOVE TREND) are secondary drivers.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tightening bias: TLT (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND imply risk assets under pressure while the yield curve shows RECOVERY (↑ rising).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leadership only: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities breadth support but limited. Tech not leading: XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND and most cyclicals/industrials weak, so style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US lagging: SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND while EM/Emerging pockets show small recovery — EEM (1W: +0.12% | 1M: -3.88%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -3.76%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IBIT (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +8.47%) ABOVE TREND signals pockets of risk-on in crypto, ARKK (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND shows selective interest, but IWM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -4.74%) BELOW TREND reflects small-cap caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity bifurcation: Oil ETFs surging — USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND — while base metals weak: CPER (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strong across the board: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND and spot oil (USO/BNO) accelerating; natural gas muted: UNG (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Credit stress signals (HYG/LQD both BELOW TREND) and extremely narrow sector breadth (2/11) validate the RISK-OFF backdrop. Divergences limited to volatility/commodities — VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -10.53% | 1M: +2.78%) CORRECTION are notable but not a major core-ETF divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor energy exposure and commodity-sensitive hedges given strong XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND and oil ETFs; reduce exposure to broad cyclicals and small caps as SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -4.74%) BELOW TREND show weakness. Monitor short-term volatility via VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND and oil ETFs USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Materials/Industrials — XME (1W: -2.94% | 1M: -5.99%) BELOW TREND and XLB (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -7.11%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil — BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper — CPER (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND and Gold — GLD (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION near ~32 marks current fear; HYG/LQD ratio (0.7302, 1W: -0.19% | 1M: +1.08%) ↓ falling flags credit stress; XLE/XLF spread (Tech vs Financials tech vs fin level 2.8156, 1W: -0.47% | 1M: +5.37%) in CORRECTION is a watch for rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF confirmed; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy ETFs showing relative strength — XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND and oil ETFs USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND. Key risks: rising credit stress HYG (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND and volatility in VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION — monitor.
